bounded_slice.observation: A self-contained replay package can reproduce both p1-sa-591 liveness boundary crossings without treating keyid as trust, but only when it carries four distinct evidence classes: authorized/configured candidate set, recorded verifier observations (or equivalent replayable cryptographic fixture), exact budget/guard semantics, and ordering-source provenance plus transformation.
bounded_slice.inference: Candidate authorization/trust provenance and ordering provenance are independent. Preserving only who was eligible is insufficient for exact replay of budget-truncated search; preserving only the effective order is also insufficient because the package would lose whether that order came from trusted configuration or an unauthenticated hint. Exact replay therefore needs both the trust/eligibility snapshot and the ordering-source record, plus the verifier-observation source and guard semantics.
bounded_slice.uncertainty: This is deterministic policy replay over persisted observations. Not tested: fresh Ed25519 execution, key rotation/revocation/freshness, duplicate identifiers, randomized/tie-breaking order, malformed keyid parsing, multiple signatures, threshold policy, heterogeneous verification cost, PKI/trust-root distribution, cross-implementation behavior, or cryptographic binding/canonicalization of the replay record itself.
